title: Do you ever get smells/tastes/temperature etc? Senses besides sight and touch?
content: I have had a few experiences ranging from pain, temperature, smells, but never taste. What are your different experiences with unique mallworld dreams where you have more senses than basic sight and movement/touch? Also do your mallworld dreams have more senses than all your "normal" dreams? Smells is the craziest one to me because i end up having SO many vs other senses. I have smelled musty, dusty, burning, fresh, good, bad, mechanical. Every smell its kinda been there. It also varies once again, though. The endless dirty bathroom doesn't stink, and if it did. I definitely wouldn't get lost so long in there. Its a terribly dirty place. The weirdest smell for honorable mention of the whole post is when I visited this weird high school that wasn't necessarily mine, it had huge windows and it almost reminded me of like some car dealership building turned school, but in a weird tony hawk skater level type way. So many stairs, rails, and then everything was white and it had weird block ledges and overhangs like brutalist design inside. The classrooms were very numerous. The smell was like plastic rubber, heavy, gross, industrial, fake, nauseating, but I was the only one that noticed it. It just smelled so plastic? For my pain senses that seems common so maybe just share those but I have full on died and felt the pain and also sometimes I dont feel anything at all. Temperature is a scary one in mallworld because its also the same as above. There has been fire and ice both in the same dreams and it varies how I do feel the temperature. I can feel hot, cold, and nice warmth that is really good. (This happens a lot at the weird swimming/waterslide park in the different pools that are combined with a normal playground.)
